propositions: Bedrock inference-profile IDs must be probed for invokability in account 896586841071/us-east-1 before corpus spend, with both bare and temperature=0 requests, per slot.
A paired corpus run must measure Bedrock vs direct Anthropic on the same 30 pooled gold-labelled eval cases across 15 specs at N=3 epochs per arm, excluding the three agentic disposable-store specs.

The measured ParityReport must show zero decision-level flips on gold set, verdict agreement >= 0.95, recall/false-accept within tolerance, zero runtime errors, and gold coverage >= 20 items; pass/fail determines if Bedrock is claimed first-class before S8 cutover.

Payload and tool parity must be proven by captured outbound requests, not code inspection, showing identical messages/system prompt/tool definitions across providers modulo 8 enumerated envelope differences.
Provider routing must be clean: zero non-Bedrock calls on the v2 arm across all measured case-runs, verified from REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally.

Capability differences that legitimately alter payloads must be explicit and recorded; temperature=0 refusal on opus must be handled by existing supports_temperature override with zero sampling rejections in practice.
